source: SEL-C0 clean-lineage candidate and V13 embedding artifacts plus SEL-D0B exact value labels
actions: STAY or unique projected ranks 1 through 10; head 1-4 and tail 5-10 reported separately
target_priority: non-breaking Complete repair actions, preferring actions that also repair 0.90 when any exist
cheapest legal cumulative-token safe-saving actions among those with identical quality and Complete
model: unchanged SEL-C1 TopKSetSelector architecture and feature schema
loss: set-valued negative log probability mass on the frozen preferred action set; one query has unit weight
split: train on pre-existing hash folds 0-3 (1421 queries); read fold4 (611 queries) once as design-exposed diagnostic, not an independent gate
candidate_evaluation: exact-cache oracle legal stopping on selected trajectory, not H0 cutoff predictions
decision: report every attainable-anchor count, Complete, 0.90 repairs/breaks, legal cumulative tokens where Complete, and paired earliest-0.90 tokens; claim no deployable improvement without a later matched learned cutoff and fresh confirmation
